source: Ed4 K.3.2.2, Table 2, pp.K-8 to K-9
description: Data queued while DCD is true waits in SENSE; when the burst ends, the DCD-determined idle starts LBT_WAIT_TIMER with lbt_wait_dcd_ms.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). The S_UNIDATA_REQUEST is priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0, U_PDU "hello"; it asks for no confirmation, so it produces no SIS output (A-0095), and it is data queued for transmission (K-0096). DCD is true from burst_started to burst_ended (K-0019, D-0018). No EOT is parsed (the receiver is P3-3), so the idle is DCD-determined and LBT rule 2 gives 30000 ms (K-0070, K-0073).
